Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 1`; GNU as gives V850 code that alignment and
pads the end of the section to it.

=== hi, lo and hi0 of a label in another section
        .text
        .p2align 1
        movhi   hi(msg), r0, r1
        movea   lo(msg), r1, r1
        movhi   hi0(msg), r0, r2
        ori     lo(msg), r2, r2
        ld.w    lo(msg)[r1], r3
        jmp     [lp]
        .data
        .p2align 1
        .space  0x8010
msg:    .long   1

=== hi and lo where the low half is negative @ 0x107ff0
        .text
        .p2align 1
here:
        movhi   hi(there), r0, r1
        movea   lo(there), r1, r1
        movhi   hi(here), r0, r2
        movea   lo(here), r2, r2
        jmp     [lp]
there:
        jmp     [lp]

=== jarl and jr into another section
        .text
        .p2align 1
entry:
        jarl    helper, lp
        jr      helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 1
helper:
        jr      entry

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 1
entry:
        jmp     [lp]
        .data
        .p2align 1
        .long   entry

=== refused: zdaoff of a label above 32 KiB
        .text
        .p2align 1
        movea   zdaoff(msg), r0, r1
        jmp     [lp]
        .data
        .p2align 1
msg:    .long   1

=== zdaoff of a label in the bottom 32 KiB @ 0x1000
        .text
        .p2align 1
        movea   zdaoff(msg), r0, r1
        addi    zdaoff(msg), r1, r2
        jmp     [lp]
        .data
        .p2align 1
msg:    .long   1
